sources.name: Wikimedia text dumps
sources.notes: Reuse is permitted subject to license obligations; model-training treatment and downstream ShareAlike/attribution compliance require project-specific legal review before promotion to the authorization registry.

sources.name: Project Gutenberg US public-domain works
sources.license: Item-specific; generally US public domain for qualifying works
sources.notes: Only individually verified qualifying works should be considered. Project Gutenberg warns that copyright status can differ outside the US and its main site restricts automated bulk access; use permitted mirrors/catalogs and verify each work before ingestion.

sources.name: Wikidata structured knowledge graph
sources.license: CC0 1.0 for structured data in the main, Property, Lexeme and EntitySchema namespaces
sources.notes: Strong candidate for Fresh's international knowledge graph because Wikidata states that its structured data is CC0 and provides multilingual structured entities, links and references. Production training promotion remains blocked until Fresh's project-specific legal review and corpus privacy/safety/quality/deduplication checks are complete.

sources.name: Lacuna Luganda Health Corpus
sources.notes: 38,644 reported English–Luganda health translation pairs with train/validation/test splits. Candidate only: project-specific commercial training and derivative-model rights, attribution, privacy, safety, and Luganda-speaker quality review must pass before authorization. Not general-purpose Luganda data.

sources.name: Luganda Foundational Literacy and Numeracy Training Data
sources.license: Apache-2.0 (dataset card; upstream source rights still require review)
sources.notes: Small, domain-specific bilingual education dataset with 1,368 reported examples across synthetic, weak-section, short-form and content subsets. Card describes textbooks, teacher assessments and AI-generated Luganda content. Verify rights to source textbooks/assessments and attribution, audit synthetic and weak-section examples with Luganda educators, and keep its scope limited to foundational literacy pedagogy.

sources.name: Luganda Sentences Corpus
sources.notes: Approximately 986,379 Luganda sentence rows plus 8,126 paragraph rows. The dataset card explicitly says reuse and redistribution conditions depend on original source licenses, including Wikipedia, GlotCC/Glot500 and FineWeb-2. Do not acquire or train until row-level/source-level license provenance and obligations can be resolved; dataset-level public availability is not permission.
